summary: This all-major build contains sm50, sm60, sm70, sm80 and sm90 machine-code variants. The CUDA source maps each warp to a row and each lane to rowStart+lane, then strides by warp width through rowEnd, reduces and stores. Main computes nItems from parsed dimensions/sparsity and passes the CLI iteration count to spmvCuda. Compiled main retains a separate warmup/synchronization and a repeated event-timed stub-launch loop with the count backedge, then syncs and copies output. Each embedded SASS architecture retains the nonzero multiply-add loops/tails, reduction and store.
